text:
Rae (Design): dropped a flow for 'anonymized export' in the trace viewer. idea: export sanitizes PII in headers/payloads and marks file as anonymized. want feedback on labels + discoverability. mock: https://imgur.com/anonymize-mock

Ethan - Eng: backend can strip headers/payloads, but we need clear UI that export is lossy. also need a checksum so support can verify they got same trace id.

Mina PM: support asked for both anonymized and raw options. default for customers should be anonymized with a clear toggle. also add a small inline note "Contains less sensitive data".

Jules Support: +1. For compliance we sometimes need raw. put raw behind a confirmation modal explaining data access and include audit logging.

Rae (Design): proposal: Export button opens a menu: "Download anonymized trace (.har)" (default) and secondary "Download raw trace (.har)" with a lock icon and modal. Add small badge "Anonymized" when default used.

a11y-bot: accessibility notes: modal must trap focus and announce purpose. include aria-describedby linking to the audit wording. ensure the anonymized badge has aria-label explaining what was removed.

Ethan - Eng: implementation notes: anonymize is performed server-side and returns a signed token. we'll include a metadata.json with fields: trace_id, anonymized: true/false, checksum, and a short admin audit url. UI should surface "Copy anonymized export info" for support to paste into tickets.

Mina PM: copying format suggestion: `Trace <id> — anonymized export ready: <shortlink>` plus a one-line summary of removed fields. Good for ticket context.

Jules Support: please make the copy action keyboard accessible and include a clear success announcement (aria-live). Also add a tiny tooltip that the export will be available for 24h.

Rae (Design): question: where to put raw export? in the kebab under Export or next to anonymized? I prefer adjacent but with lock so users see both options quickly.

Ethan - Eng: adjacent is fine. clicking raw opens confirmation modal with checkbox "I have permission to view raw traces" and logs the action. backend returns the raw artifact only after audit log created.

a11y-bot: keyboard shortcuts: keep K for play toggle, arrows scrub. ensure confirmation modal is dismissible with Escape and the checkbox is focusable. Add descriptive aria-labels for the lock icon buttons.

Rae (Design): shareflow: add a "Share to Slack" quick action after export completes (copies link + posts to #support-dumps if user consents). default off. note privacy implications in modal.

Mina PM: consent default off is required. opt-in per export. auditing must capture user action and destination.

Jules Support: that Slack quick-post would save time. include option to paste short summary in the Slack message: trace id, anonymized/raw, time window.

Ethan - Eng: will add webhook flow; sharebot can prefill text and ask user to confirm before posting. ensure tokens aren't leaked in messages.

Rae (Design): microcopy picks: use "Download anonymized trace (.har)" and in modal header "Request raw trace (requires approval)". Tooltip for anonymized badge: "Sensitive fields removed: headers, cookies, request bodies".

Mina PM: decision list: 1) default export = anonymized (.har) with badge; 2) raw export adjacent with lock + confirm modal + audit log; 3) copy action for export info (trace id + shortlink + removed fields); 4) Slack share optional opt-in after export; 5) accessibility: modal trap, aria-describedby, aria-live confirmations, keyboard flow K/arrows; 6) export availability notice (24h). Proceed?

Ethan - Eng: no objections. I'll draft API changes and add audit hooks.

Jules Support: will update triage docs to reflect copy format.

sharebot: Preview: https://redwood-inference.dev/trace-anon/2019998887 (expires in 24h) :rocket:

Rae (Design): pairing review at 10:30. I'll update frames and include the a11y checklist after the meeting. :white_check_mark:
